notes.subject: han sut i lus
notes.rationale: Hebrew says only 'let my right hand forget' with no object; KJV adds 'her cunning' (skill on the harp), BSB 'cease to function' — object is elided.

notes.subject: אשכחך/תשכח
notes.rationale: Root שכח repeated twice — 'if I forget you … let it forget' — the oath-curse echoes the verb.

notes.subject: object of תשכח
notes.rationale: Hebrew omits what the right hand forgets; Tok Pisin supplies ⟨olgeta tingting⟩ in brackets.

translation: Sapos mi lus tingting long yu, Yerusalayim, bai han sut bilong mi i lus ⟨olgeta tingting⟩ bilong en.
